1A. Walau apa pun kaedah 1, Hakim Mahkamah Tinggi boleh atas
usulnya sendiri dan pada peringkat seawal mungkin prosiding
di Mahkamah Tinggi, memerintahkan tindakan itu dipindahkan
ke Mahkamah Sesyen jika dia berpuas hati bahawa semua hal keadaan
termasuk dan tidak terhad kepada kepentingan pihak -pihak,

hal perkara  dan nilai tuntutan, adil dan sesuai untuk didengar dan
dilupuskan di Mahkamah Sesyen.".

Pindaan Aturan 59

RULES OF COURT (AMENDMENT) 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 17 of
the Courts of Judicature Act 1964 [ Act 91 ] and section 4 of the Subordinate Courts
Rules Act 1955 [ Act 55 ], and with the consent of the Chief Judge of the High Court in
Malaya and the Chief Judge of the High Court in Sabah and Sarawak, the Rules Committee
and the Subordinate Courts Rules Committee make the following rules:

Citation
1. These rules may be cited as the Rules of Court (Amendment) 2025.

General amendment
2. The Rules of Court 2012 [ P.U. (A) 205/2012 ], which are referred to as
the "principal Rules" in these Rules, are amended—

(a) by substituting for the word "Controller" wherever appearing ,
except in Order 1, the word "Bank"; and

(b) by substituting for the words "scheduled territories" wherever appearing ,
except in Order 1, the word "Malaysia".

Amendment of Order 1
3. Order 1, rule 4(1) of the principal Rules is amended—

(a) by deleting the definition of "Controller";

(b) by inserting after the definition of "bailiff" the following definition:

‘  "Bank" has the meaning assigned to it in the Financial Services Act 2013
[Act 758]';
(c) in the definition of "moneylender's action", by substituting for the semicolon
at the end of the paragraph a full stop; and

(d) by deleting the definition of "scheduled territories".

Amendment of Order 6
4. Order 6, rule 7 of the principal Rules is amended—

(a) in paragraph (2), by deleting the words "and in admiralty actions five times";
and

(b) by inserting after paragraph (5) the following paragraph:

"(6)  Paragraphs (1) and (2) shall not apply to an y originating
claim relating to Admiralty causes and matters.".

Amendment of Order 57
5. Order 57 of the principal Rules is amended—

(a) in rule 1(2), by deleting the word "only"; and

(b) by inserting after rule 1 the following rule:

"Transfer of proceedings to Sessions Court (O. 57, r. 1A)
  1A.  Notwithstanding rule 1, a Judge of the High Court may on his own
motion and at the earliest possible stage of the proceedings in
the High Court, order the action to be transferred to the Sessions Court
if he is satisfied that based on all the circumstances including but not
limited to the interest s of the parties , subject matter  and value of
the claim, it would be just and appropriate to be heard and disposed of
in the Sessions Court.".

Amendment of Order 59

(a) in rule 20—

(i) by inserting after the words "Subordinate Courts" the words
"unless the Court orders otherwise,";

but not exceeding RM15,000.00; and"; and

"(b) in the Sessions Court, a sum of not less than RM3,000.00
but not exceeding RM40,000.00.";
